title: Why Human
html: Human is the best race here, a little ahead of Dwarf and Undead: The Human Spirit's extra Spirit keeps your mana up in long fights.

title: Free talent points
html: Every Holy talent that helps healing is taken, so 7 points sit in Retribution talents that don't heal. Spend them as you like.

title: Why Windshaper
html: Windshaper is the best race for both. Its edge over the other races is small.

title: Swiftmend keeps your HoT
html: On Forever, Swiftmend doesn't use up the Rejuvenation or Regrowth it eats. That's why Swiftmend comes up so often in these rotations.

title: Overhealing
html: The raid druid overheals a lot, about 60% of its healing, as HoTs land on people who are already full. It doesn't run out of mana, so it doesn't matter much.

title: Riptide
html: Riptide here only puts the heal over time on the target, not the instant heal: Forever's patch notes don't mention one. If Riptide does heal up front in game, the raid shaman would score a bit higher (about 0.07).

title: Holy or Discipline
html: On the tank, Holy and Discipline heal about the same. Discipline runs tighter on mana in long fights.

title: Prayer of Healing
html: Prayer of Healing is weak here: these groups rarely have five hurt players at once. Most of the healing is Flash Heal, Greater Heal and Prayer of Mending.
